name: io.github.fecklesspleb/actors-mcp
title: fecklesspleb Apify Actors
description: 14 tools for fecklesspleb's Apify Actors: SEO, metadata, sitemaps, HN, jobs; 4 web tools opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Apify API token. Actor runs are billed to this Apify account per result.

environmentVariables.name: FECKLESSPLEB_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: core, jobs, web, or all. Default: core,jobs.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_MAX_COST_USD
environmentVariables.description: Default spending cap per tool call, in USD.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_MAX_COST_CEILING_USD
environmentVariables.description: Highest per-call cap a tool call may request, in USD.
